status: pikeman, ranger and mage published pending user style approval
method: inputs: codex built-in image_gen front/back orthographic references (tools/roster_imagegen.py), guard + crossbow images as style references only; mechanical QA tools/unit_input_qa.py inspect_png
body: TripoSR (pinned cache, tools/neural_pilot_v2.py) + front/rear projection (tools/neural_pilot_v3.py) + Blender import QA (tools/neural_blender_qa_v3.py)
prep: tools/roster_unit_prepare.py (human-units v2 texel team mask; 'steel-safe' profile keeps blue-steel armour out of the mask)

build: tools/roster_<unit>_build.py in Blender 5.2: published 20-bone unit rig with joints fitted to the body, auto weights + arm-chain reweight + spatial shoulder smoothing + continuous tabard skirt weights, wrist cut, closed hands from tools/roster_hands.py (solid palm hugging the haft, four touching three-phalanx fingers with back-of-fist knuckles wrapping into the palm heel, crossing thumb, rigid Hand-bone palm with the wrist bend confined to a capped cuff; ranger draw hand is a split-finger hook on a served string; mage left hand is the generated hand rigidly re-weighted to Hand_L; straight-wrist two-bone IK keeps the forearm on the palm line via haft roll (pike, staff) or bow-space calibration (bow), with unwrapped forearm twist and swing-plane continuity; review pages carry idle/attack hand close-ups), procedural weapon, every clip baked per frame with analytic two-bone IK so both hands stay on the weapon, LOD1 with protected wrist/hand/foot vertices
pack: tools/roster_pack.py (detail-v1 shared surfaces, content-addressed unit-shared body atlas, lossless compaction)
publish: tools/roster_publish.py (refuses unless every gate passed for the exact candidate SHA)

gates.integrity: tools/roster_integrity.py: exact clips, one 20-joint skin identical across LODs, weights normalized <1e-5 and <=4 influences, increasing keys, equal durations, LOD0 8k-20k / LOD1 4k-10k triangles, rtsMotion equal in both LODs, conservative bounds on every skinned node, team mask <= 3 MB, bytes <= guard pair, floor >= -5 mm and Idle <= 3 cm
gates.hand_contact: tools/roster_hand_qa.py: gap -6..+8 mm, >= 12/16 wrap sectors (>= 8/16 for a draw hand hooked on the string), 0 cuff/weapon crossings, 31 samples per clip per LOD; released support hand recorded
gates.runtime_collision: tools/all_models_runtime_collision.py on all_models_runtime_pose.mjs samples: 0 body/weapon crossings
gates.bounds: tools/roster_bounds_check.py: every skinned vertex inside rtsConservativeBounds at <= 1/60 s sampling
gates.source: build report: zero source crossings, IK residual <= 1 mm on every clip

review: art-factory/rts/review/roster-<unit>-20261016.html via tools/roster_review_capture.mjs (runtime ModelInstance, own Astro dev port) and tools/roster_review_page.py
preview_gate: UNITS[kind].preview stays true and kind stays out of REQUIRED_MODELS while model-registry user_style_approval is 'pending' (roster.test.ts)
